# TD-8: More demo friends so the leaderboard looks like a real friend group

- **Date:** 2026-11-15
- **Decided by:** Team 9 (the team agreed; approved by Rafael Amador, project manager)
- **Changes:** Extends TD-2 (demo accounts). Demo data only; no behavior change.

## Decision
1. Seed four more demo students: **starryskies23** (Sky), **nebulanomad** (Nova) (both usernames from prototype 4-social), **lunarlifter** (Luna) and **orbitrunner** (Theo). Same rules as TD-2: all sharing on, password and TOTP secret listed in `app/README.md` like alice and bob.
2. All six demo students (alice, bob and the four new ones) are friends with each other, so alice's Social screen ranks six people.
3. Give each a week of realistic history (meals from the real TD-6 dining items, water, steps, UREC visits and points) with different levels, so the rankings differ by board and alice is first on none of them and last on none of them. For example one friend is the water leader, another the UREC regular, another logs the most calories. Today's numbers must be filled in too, since the boards show "today".
4. Include one pending friend request to alice from one more demo student, **cosmocomet** (Cass), so the Friend requests list is not empty in the demo.
5. Resetting the demo data recreates all of this cleanly.

## Why
With only bob as a friend, the leaderboard showed two names, which does not demonstrate UC-3 well in the recorded demo.
# TD-2: Demo accounts share their data

- **Date:** 2026-11-13
- **Decided by:** Team 9 (approved by Rafael Amador, project manager, after testing the stage-1 app)
- **Changes:** Assumption A-18 (default sharing) for the seeded demo accounts only.

## Decision
The seeded demo students (alice and bob) start with all data sharing turned on (calories, water, steps, UREC visits) and have some activity history, so UC-3 (friends' progress and leaderboard) shows real numbers in the recorded demo.
Real new accounts keep the current behavior: nothing is shared until the student turns it on (NFR Ethical / Legislative-Privacy).

## Why
In testing, the friends screen showed "Not shared" for every stat and the leaderboard listed only one person, so UC-3 could not be demonstrated.
# TD-6: Real UTD Dining locations and menu items

- **Date:** 2026-11-15
- **Decided by:** Team 9 (the team agreed; approved by Rafael Amador, project manager)
- **Changes:** Supersedes A-16 (stub feed with two placeholder locations and placeholder items). FR-8, UC-1 "Browse Campus Dining Menu".

## Decision
1. The dining feed must serve the real UTD Dining locations and items in `spec/06-utd-dining/utd-dining-menus-2026-11-16.json`: Dining Hall West, Chick-fil-A, Panda Express, The Halal Shack, Firehouse Subs, Taco Bell Cantina and Starbucks (54 items). Use the item names, serving sizes and nutrition numbers exactly as given. Remove the old placeholder locations and items ("Dining Hall", "Campus Store").
2. Every item in that file was on UTD Dining's official menu site (Dine On Campus, linked from services.utdallas.edu/dining/menus/) for Monday, Nov 16, 2026. The source URL is listed per location. Show the building next to each location name.
3. Where the source publishes only calories (null fat/carbs/protein), store and show the macros as "not published"; do not invent numbers, and daily totals must still work (count them as 0 g for macro totals, and say so in ASSUMPTIONS.md).
4. Keep it a stub of the external "UTD Dining (menu data)" actor (no live calls to Dine On Campus); only its data changes. Existing meal entries that point at removed placeholder items may be cleared when the demo data is reset.
5. The demo data (TD-2) should use some of these real items in alice's and bob's meal history.

## Why
The team wanted the dining feature to show places students can actually eat on campus, with items that are actually sold there.

54. Not verified: the sign-in header in a real browser or phone (no browser tool in this run), and native icons/splash (no native build).
55. Docs: TRACEABILITY TD-7 + both logo files as source rows; ASSUMPTIONS A-58..A-60.
A-53 | (stage 4) Item order inside a location | Order as listed in the JSON (the source's order), not alphabetical as before; only items currently in the feed are returned. A-54 | (stage 4) Where the building (TD-6 §2 "show the building next to each location name") comes from in the API | New `GET /api/nutrition/menu/location-info` returns name, building, menu label, source URL and `macrosPublished`; `GET /api/nutrition/menu/locations` still returns plain names (no break for existing callers). A-55 | (stage 4) How daily macro totals treat "not published" macros (TD-6 §3 asks to say so here) | A null macro counts as **0 g** in the daily protein / carbs / fat totals (calories are always published and always counted). The summary adds `mealsWithUnpublishedMacros`; Food & Water and Dashboard show "N items have macros not published by UTD Dining; counted as 0 g in these totals." A published 0 (e.g. Caffe Americano fat 0 g) is a real 0, not "not published". Manual and photo entries keep blank macro fields = 0 (unchanged). | TD-6 §3; FR-2, FR-8; UC-1 "View Daily Summary & Goals"
A-56 | (stage 4) What happens on an existing database to meal entries logged from removed placeholder items | V5 detaches them (`dining_item_id` set to NULL; name, calories and macros copied at logging time are kept) and deletes the placeholder `dining_items` rows. Every other asset keeps the original green and orange. | TD-7 §2, §3
A-60 | (stage 5) Logo size and position on the sign-in flow screens | Same place on all four steps: in one row to the left of the "CometFit" wordmark (as prototype 1-sign-in), 64 x 41 px (aspect ratio kept from the 938 x 598 logo), 10 px gap; `assets/logo.png` is a 256 px wide transparent copy for sharp display on high-density screens. # Traceability

Paths: `S/` = `app/server/src/main/java/cometfit/`, `T/` = `app/server/src/test/java/cometfit/`,
`C/` = `app/client/`, `M/` = `app/server/src/main/resources/db/migration/`.

# Assumptions

Every gap that had to be filled because `spec/` (Project Proposal = "Prop", Deliverable 1 = "D1", Deliverable 2 draft = "D2",
team repo code = "TRC", team decisions = "TD-n") is silent or ambiguous. Code comments reference these IDs.
Rows answered by a later input are kept and marked **SUPERSEDED by ...** (stage 2).

Load balancing is not built for a laptop demo; telemetry = health checks + uptime records (FR-1). | D1 §5.3.1, §5.3.2, §5.3.3
A-2 | Which database product; Docker Engine not running on the build machine | PostgreSQL 16 (docker-compose) is the default. An `h2` Spring profile (embedded file DB, PostgreSQL mode) lets the app run and be tested without Docker. The same Flyway schema is used for both. | D1 §5.3.2 "Encrypted Database"; Prop §9 "Database for the app" **SUPERSEDED by `spec/04-team-repo-code/README.md` ("MySQL for database operations") and `db/docker-compose.yml` (`mysql:8.4`): database is now MySQL 8.4; see A-33.**
A-3 | How accounts are created (every use case includes "Log In" but there is no sign-up use case) | Students self-register (username, password, email, display name) and get a TOTP secret to add to an authenticator app. Developer accounts are created by seed/config only. | D1 Fig 4.3 "Log In (Password + TOTP)"; NFR Security **SUPERSEDED (TOTP setup part) by `spec/03-team-decisions/TD-1.md` (1), (2): after sign-up the app shows "Add to authenticator app" and "Copy setup key", and a QR code only on larger screens; self-registration itself is unchanged. See A-39.**
A-4 | Credential rules | Username 3–30 chars `[A-Za-z0-9_.]`, unique (case-insensitive); password ≥ 8 chars; email must look like an address. | NFR Security
A-5 | What "all user data will be encrypted" means concretely | Passwords: BCrypt hash. Email and TOTP secret: AES-256-GCM field encryption (key from `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY`). Other tables (meals, steps, …) rely on database/disk-level encryption in a real deployment, because the app must sum and query them. TLS is expected from the deployment's reverse proxy; the local demo uses plain HTTP. | NFR Security, NFR Legislative-Security; D1 §5.3.2 "Encrypted Database"
A-6 | Login flow detail and session lifetime | One login call carries username + password + 6-digit TOTP code; a Session (random 256-bit token, Bearer header) is created only if both factors pass, and lasts 12 h. `AuthService.authenticate` therefore takes the TOTP code as a third argument. TOTP = RFC 6238, SHA-1, 30 s, ±1 step. | D1 §5.2 AuthService, Session; NFR Security **SUPERSEDED (code on every sign-in) by `spec/03-team-decisions/TD-1.md` (3): "Remember this device for 30 days"; a remembered device signs in with username + password only. A-8 | Where the water-bottle size lives (Prop: "volume of the user's water bottle … number of refills"; SD-1 "log water (bottle size / refill)"; class diagram has no field) | Added `bottleSizeMl` to Student (set in Profile → Goals). The app logs a refill as `saveWaterEntry(bottleSizeMl)`, plus half bottle or a custom amount. | Prop §4; D1 SD-1
A-9 | What "daily" means (time zone of the day boundary) | Configurable `COMETFIT_ZONE`, default America/Chicago (D1 cites the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act, so the users are in Texas). | D1 UC-1 "View Daily Summary & Goals"
A-10 | Thresholds for an "unsafe goal" | Warn when calorie goal < 1200 or > 4000 kcal, water goal < 1000 or > 4000 ml, step goal > 30 000 (Prop risk "User over-exertion → Warnings of the app"). The goal is still saved; the app only warns (NFR says "allow a warning"). | D1 NFR Safety; Prop §8
A-11 | Which "portions of the app" can be shut down | Three modules, each mapped to an API prefix: NUTRITION (`/api/nutrition`), ACTIVITY (`/api/activity`), SOCIAL (`/api/social`). Login, profile and admin cannot be disabled. A disabled module answers 503 `MODULE_DISABLED`, and the client shows a maintenance notice on those tabs. | FR-5; D1 UC-4, SD-4 ("disable module (e.g. Friends)")
A-12 | How external systems (UREC card reader, monitoring service) authenticate | Shared secret in header `X-Integration-Key` (`COMETFIT_INTEGRATION_KEY`). A-13 | Names and contents of the "backend permissions list" | Students implicitly hold `nutrition.use`, `activity.use`, `social.use`, `profile.use`. A-22 | What `isPublic` controls | Non-friends viewing a private profile see only the username, not the display name or member-since date. Search by username always works, so friend requests are still possible. | D1 §5.2 User.isPublic; FR-3; Prop §4 "user-entered public information"

A-25 | Which "servers" are monitored, how often, how long records are kept | 7 components named after the §5.3.2 boxes (api-gateway, auth-gateway, nutrition-service, activity-service, social-service, admin-service, database), each with a real probe. A-34 | (stage 2) How the team's WATER_LOG table and LogWater unit fit the app's schema: column names, user id type, and what "fullName" is (team USERS has firstName/lastName; the class diagram User has only displayName) | Table `water_log(id, user_id BIGINT -> users.id, amount FLOAT(24) liters, logged_at DEFAULT now)`: the team's columns in this schema's snake_case and with the users key type (the team's `userId VARCHAR(64)` cannot reference an INT/BIGINT key). A-39 | (stage 2) TD-1 details: how the authenticator app is opened, what "larger screen" means, how a device is remembered | "Add to authenticator app" opens the standard `otpauth://totp/CometFit:<username>?secret=…&issuer=CometFit` link (account filled in); if nothing opens, the app says to use "Copy setup key". A-42 | (stage 3) TD-5 "short-lived, single-use challenge": how long it lives, how many wrong codes it allows, how it is sent | `POST /api/auth/login` {username, password, deviceToken?} returns either a session (remembered device) or `verificationRequired: true` + a random 256-bit `challengeId` and no token. `POST /api/auth/verify` {challengeId, totpCode, rememberDevice} completes it. # Traceability

`C/` = `app/client/`, `M/` = `app/server/src/main/resources/db/migration/`.
Spec: Prop = Project Proposal, D1 = Deliverable 1, D2 = Deliverable 2 draft (`spec/02-deliverable-2-draft/`),
TRC = team repo code (`spec/04-team-repo-code/`), TD-n = team decisions (`spec/03-team-decisions/`).

# CometFit — local setup and demo guide

CometFit (SE 3354 Team 9) is a student health-tracking app: meals and water (UC-1), activity and UREC visits (UC-2),
friends' progress (UC-3), and developer monitoring and control (UC-4). It was built only from the team's Proposal,
Deliverable 1, the Deliverable 2 draft, the team's water-logging unit code, team decisions TD-1..TD-5 and the team's Figma prototype screens (all in `../spec/`). `../TRACEABILITY.md` maps every requirement to code and tests. `../ASSUMPTIONS.md` lists every gap
that had to be filled.

```
app/
├── server/            Spring Boot REST server: API gateway, auth gateway, Nutrition / Activity / Social / Admin services
├── client/            Expo (React Native) mobile app — also runs in a web browser for the demo
├── tools/             totp.mjs (prints sign-in codes), smoke.mjs (end-to-end HTTP check), demo-check.mjs (read-only)
└── docker-compose.yml MySQL 8.4 database + the server
```

The architecture follows Deliverable 1 §5.3 (client-server): the mobile client talks to one REST API, and every call
goes through the auth gateway (password + TOTP sessions, permissions list) and the module (feature-flag) check before
it reaches a service. Outside systems (AI food recognition, UTD Dining menus, smart devices, the UREC card reader,
the monitoring service and the alert channel) are **stubs**. They are labelled `*** STUB ***` in the code and listed at
the end of this file.

---

## 1. Install prerequisites

| Tool | Version used | Check with |
|---|---|---|
| Java JDK | 21 or newer (built with 23) | `java -version` |
| Maven | 3.9+ | `mvn -v` |
| Node.js + npm | Node 22+ | `node -v` |
| Docker Desktop | recommended (MySQL + server) | `docker version` |

Without Docker, use the embedded H2 database (step 4, option B).

## 2. Install dependencies

```bash
# server (downloads the Maven dependencies)
cd app/server
mvn -DskipTests package

# client
cd ../client
npm install
```

## 3. Configure environment variables

Every variable has a development default, so **nothing needs to be set for a local demo**. For anything shared, set
at least `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY`, `DB_PASSWORD`, `DB_ROOT_PASSWORD` and `COMETFIT_INTEGRATION_KEY`.

### Server (`app/server`)

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `PORT` | `8080` | HTTP port |
| `DB_URL` | `jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/cometfit` (H2 file `./data/cometfit-mysql` with the `h2` profile) | JDBC URL |
| `DB_USER` / `DB_PASSWORD` | `cometfit` / `cometfit` | Database login |
| `DB_ROOT_PASSWORD` | `root` | MySQL root password (docker-compose only) |
| `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY` | development key | Base64 32-byte AES key that encrypts emails and TOTP secrets at rest. Generate one: `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))"`. **Changing it makes existing accounts unreadable.** |
| `COMETFIT_INTEGRATION_KEY` | `dev-integration-key` | Shared secret that the UREC card reader and the external monitor send in the `X-Integration-Key` header |
| `COMETFIT_ZONE` | `America/Chicago` | Time zone that defines "today" for daily totals |
| `COMETFIT_SESSION_HOURS` | `12` | Session lifetime |
| `COMETFIT_REMEMBER_DEVICE_DAYS` | `30` | How long "Remember this device" skips the 6-digit code (TD-1) |
| `COMETFIT_MONITOR_INTERVAL_SEC` | `30` | Health-check interval of the monitoring stub |
| `COMETFIT_MONITOR_STUB` | `true` | Run the built-in monitoring-service stub |
| `COMETFIT_SEED_DEMO` | `true` | Create the demo accounts below on start-up |
| `COMETFIT_CORS_ORIGINS` | `http://localhost:8081,http://localhost:19006` | Browser origins allowed to call the API |

### Client (`app/client`)

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` (`http://10.0.2.2:8080` on the Android emulator) | Server base URL |

To set variables: in bash, `export NAME=value`. In PowerShell, `$env:NAME = "value"`. You can also put client
variables in `app/client/.env` (this file is git-ignored).

## 4. Run the project locally

### Start the database and server

**Option A — everything in Docker (recommended)**

```bash
cd app
docker compose up --build        # MySQL 8.4 on localhost:3306 + the server on localhost:8080
```

Add `-d` to run it in the background. The server waits until MySQL is healthy. The first build downloads the Maven
dependencies inside the image, so it takes a few minutes.

**Option A2 — MySQL in Docker, server from Maven (for development)**

```bash
cd app
docker compose up -d db
cd server
mvn spring-boot:run
```

**Option B — no Docker (embedded H2 file database in MySQL mode)**

```bash
cd app/server
mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=h2
```

Flyway creates the schema on first start (`V1` schema, `V2` water log in liters, `V3` remembered devices, `V4` sign-in
challenges for TD-5, `V5` UTD Dining building / serving size and nullable macros for TD-6). The server
is ready when <http://localhost:8080/actuator/health> shows `{"status":"UP"}`.

**Start the demo over with clean data** (removes everything, including test leftovers, then re-seeds the demo accounts):

```bash
cd app
docker compose down -v           # -v deletes the MySQL volume
docker compose up --build
```

With option B, stop the server and delete `app/server/data/` instead. *(Upgrading from the stage-1 PostgreSQL build:
the old `app_cometfit-db` volume and old H2 files are not used any more; delete them.)*

### Start the client

```bash
cd app/client
npm run web            # opens http://localhost:8081 in the browser
```

For a phone-like view in the browser, use the dev tools' device toolbar. On a real phone, run `npx expo start` and
open the app in Expo Go. Set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` to your laptop's LAN address, for example
`http://192.168.1.20:8080`.

### Sign in

| Username | Password | TOTP secret | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alice` | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITALICE234` | Student |
| `bob` | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITBOBBY567` | Student |
| `dev` | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITDEVADMIN` | Developer (admin dashboard) |

Sign-in has two steps (team decision TD-5):

1. **Sign in** — enter the username and password and press *Sign in*. No code is asked here.
2. **Verify it's you** — shown only when this browser/phone is not remembered. Enter the current 6-digit code from
   Duo Mobile (or any authenticator app with the secret above added), or print it with:

   ```bash
   node app/tools/totp.mjs COMETFITALICE234
   ```

   Tick **Remember this device for 30 days** to skip step 2 next time on this browser/phone (TD-1). The code is
   needed again on a new device, after 30 days, after a password change, or after *Account → Two-step verification →
   Forget this device*. The sign-in step expires after 5 minutes; if it does, press *Back to sign in*.

**Register** (from *New student? Create an account*) asks only for the account details. The next screen, **Set up
two-step verification**, shows a QR code to scan with Duo Mobile (on every screen size), plus **Add to authenticator
app** and **Copy setup key**. Enter the first 6-digit code and press *Finish setup* to sign in.

The demo students `alice` and `bob` are already friends, share all their stats, and have a week of meals, water,
steps, UREC visits and points (TD-2); their meals are real UTD Dining items (TD-6). Accounts you register yourself share nothing until you turn sharing on.

## 5. Run the tests

```bash
cd app/server && mvn test        # 70 API/unit tests on H2 (MySQL mode): Uc1..Uc4, WaterLogTest (team TC-1..TC-3),
                                 # RememberDeviceTest (TD-1), DemoDataTest (TD-2, TD-6), TwoStepSignInTest (TD-5),
                                 # Td6UtdDiningTest + StubUtdDiningFeedTest (TD-6), security
cd app/client && npm test        # 32 client unit tests (Node test runner), incl. authFlow (TD-5), td6Dining (TD-6)
cd app/client && npm run typecheck
cd app/client && npx expo export --platform web   # production web build in app/client/dist (= npm run export:web)

# End-to-end over real HTTP against a running server (uses the demo accounts; it logs meals/water for alice,
# so reset the demo data afterwards if you want it clean):
node app/tools/smoke.mjs http://localhost:8080
# Read-only: demo accounts sign in, TD-6 dining data, demo meals (writes nothing):
node app/tools/demo-check.mjs http://localhost:8080
```

## 6. Demo script (about 5 minutes)

Start from clean demo data (`docker compose down -v`, then `docker compose up --build`).

The five tabs follow the team's Figma prototype (TD-4): **Dashboard, Food & Water, Activities, Social, Account**.

0. **Sign-in (TD-5, TD-1)** — Sign in as `alice` with username and password; *Verify it's you* asks for the code.
   Tick *Remember this device for 30 days* and *Verify*. Log out (Account) and sign in again: no second step. To
   show sign-up, register a new student: *Set up two-step verification* shows the QR code for Duo Mobile, *Add to
   authenticator app* and *Copy setup key*; enter the first code to finish.
1. **UC-1** — **Dashboard** shows the UREC streak and a *Today* card (calories, water, steps, low-water message). On
   **Food & Water**, tap *+ 500 ml* (one bottle refill). Tap *Other amount (L / gal)*, enter `0.3`, choose *gal* and
   tap *Add 1.13 L*: the app answers "Added 1.13L to Alice" (water is stored in liters). A negative amount is not
   accepted. Tap *+ Log food*: log a meal manually, then *Dining menu*: the 7 UTD Dining locations with their
   buildings (TD-6). Open *Dining Hall West (Andromeda Hall)* — calories only, macros "not published" — and *Add*
   *Italian Nachos*; the macro totals note that it counts as 0 g. Open *Chick-fil-A* to show an item with published
   macros. Then *Photo (AI)* → pick any image, edit the estimate, *Confirm & save*. *Today's log* lists every entry;
   *Week* / *Month* show averages per day. alice's and bob's earlier days are real UTD Dining items (TD-6 §5).
2. **Safety** — in **Account → Daily goals & units**, enter 800 kcal or 6000 ml and watch the warnings appear.
3. **UC-2** — **Activities** → *+ Connect smart device* → *Allow* (simulated health prompt) → *+ Sync activity from
   device*. Then *Check in at UREC* (here or on the Dashboard): +10 points, the visit appears in the history and the
   Dashboard streak updates.
4. **UC-3** — **Social**: the friends leaderboards (water, calories, UREC visits, points) show alice and bob (TD-2).
   Open bob's *Stats*. In **Account → Privacy & data** turn one of alice's sharing switches off, then in a second
   (private) browser window sign in as `bob` and see alice drop off that board and the stat show "Not shared". To
   show friend requests, register a new student and send `alice` a request (*Find people*).
5. **UC-4** — Sign in as `dev`. The developer dashboard shows uptime % and per-component status. Click *Simulate
   outage* on a component to see a downtime alert and an incident, then end it. *Disable* "Friends & Leaderboard" and
   switch to bob's window: the Social tab shows the maintenance notice while the other tabs keep working.
   *Re-enable* it.

Not built on purpose: the Proposal's water refill map (team decision TD-3, `../ASSUMPTIONS.md` A-41).

## 7. Stubs (external systems from the spec)

| External actor in the spec | Interface | Stub implementation |
|---|---|---|
| AI Food Recognition Service (UC-1) | `services/AIFoodService` | `stubs/FakeAIFoodService` — deterministic estimate from the image hash |
| UTD Dining menu data (UC-1, FR-8) | `services/UtdDiningFeed` | `stubs/StubUtdDiningFeed` — TD-6: the 7 UTD Dining locations / 54 items of `spec/06-utd-dining` (Monday 2026-11-16 menus, classpath copy `utd-dining/…json`), same menu every day, no live calls |
| Smart Device pairing (UC-2) | `services/SmartDeviceGateway` | `stubs/FakeSmartDeviceGateway` — always pairs, except device ids starting with `FAIL` |
| Smart Device readings + health permission (UC-2) | client `src/smartDevice.ts` `SmartDeviceAdapter` | `FakeSmartDevice` — simulated steps / heart rate |
| UREC Card Reader (UC-2) | `POST /api/activity/visits` with the integration key | `stubs/FakeUrecCardReader` — the "Check in at UREC" buttons (Dashboard, Activities) |
| Monitoring Service (UC-4) | `POST /api/admin/health-check` with the integration key | `stubs/MonitoringAgentStub` — timer inside the server |
| Downtime alert channel (UC-4) | `services/AlertNotifier` | `stubs/LoggingAlertNotifier` — logs the alert and shows it on the dashboard |
| A real outage (demo only) | — | `stubs/OutageSimulator` — the "Simulate outage" button |

## 8. REST API overview

All endpoints except register, login and health need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

| Area | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register`, `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/verify`, `POST /api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me` |
| Profile (FR-3) | `GET/PUT /api/profile`, `PUT /api/profile/password`, `PUT /api/profile/goals` |
| Nutrition (UC-1) | `POST /api/nutrition/meals/photo`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/locations`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/location-info` (TD-6: building, menu, source), `GET /api/nutrition/menu?location=`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/meals`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/water`, `GET /api/nutrition/summary` |
| Activity (UC-2) | `POST/GET /api/activity/devices`, `DELETE /api/activity/devices/{id}`, `POST /api/activity/steps`, `GET /api/activity/records`, `POST /api/activity/visits` (reader), `GET /api/activity/visits`, `POST /api/activity/stub-reader/swipe` |
| Social (UC-3) | `GET /api/social/users/search?q=`, `GET /api/social/users/{id}`, `POST/GET /api/social/requests`, `POST /api/social/requests/{id}/accept\|decline`, `GET /api/social/friends`, `DELETE /api/social/friends/{id}`, `GET/PUT /api/social/consent`, `GET /api/social/friends/{id}/stats`, `GET /api/social/leaderboard` |
| Modules (FR-5) | `GET /api/modules`, `GET /api/modules/{id}` |
| Admin (UC-4) | `GET /api/admin/access`, `GET /api/admin/uptime?hours=`, `POST /api/admin/uptime/check-now`, `GET /api/admin/alerts`, `GET /api/admin/modules`, `POST /api/admin/modules/{id}/disable\|enable`, `POST /api/admin/health-check` (monitor), `POST /api/admin/stub/outage` |

Sign-in (stage 3, TD-5): `POST /api/auth/login` takes `username`, `password` and optional `deviceToken` (a remembered
device). It returns a session (`token`, `user`, `rememberedDevice: true`) only for a remembered device; otherwise
`verificationRequired: true` with a single-use `challengeId` (5 minutes) and **no** token. `POST /api/auth/verify`
takes `challengeId`, `totpCode` and optional `rememberDevice` and returns the session, plus `deviceToken` /
`trustedUntil` when the device was just remembered. `POST /api/auth/register` returns `totpSecret`, `otpauthUri` and a
`setupChallengeId` (15 minutes) that the first code completes through `/verify`. Every credential failure is the same
`401 "Invalid username, password or code"`. `POST /api/nutrition/water` takes `{"amount": 0.3, "isLiter": false}` (liters or gallons, team
`LogWater`) or `{"volumeMl": 500}`, and returns `message` (for example "Added 1.13L to Alice").

When a module is disabled, its endpoints answer `503 {"code":"MODULE_DISABLED"}` and the app shows a maintenance
notice.

## Troubleshooting

- **"Cannot reach the CometFit server"** in the app: the server isn't running, or `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` is wrong.
- **"Invalid username, password or code" on Verify it's you:** the 6-digit code is wrong or expired, the laptop clock
  is off, or the sign-in step timed out (5 minutes) / had 5 wrong codes — press *Back to sign in* and start again.
- **Port 8080 already in use:** set `PORT=8090` before starting the server, and set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8090` for the client.
- **CORS error in the browser:** add the page's origin to `COMETFIT_CORS_ORIGINS`.
- **"Could not decrypt field":** `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY` changed after the accounts were created. Restore the old key or reset the database.

0. **Sign-in (TD-5, TD-1)** — Sign in as `alice` with username and password; *Verify it's you* asks for the code.
   Tick *Remember this device for 30 days* and *Verify*. Log out (Account) and sign in again: no second step. To
   show sign-up, register a new student: *Set up two-step verification* shows the QR code for Duo Mobile, *Add to
   authenticator app* and *Copy setup key*; enter the first code to finish.
1. **UC-1** — **Dashboard** shows the UREC streak and a *Today* card (calories, water, steps, low-water message). On
   **Food & Water**, tap *+ 500 ml* (one bottle refill). Tap *Other amount (L / gal)*, enter `0.3`, choose *gal* and

   accepted. Tap *+ Log food*: log a meal manually, then *Dining menu*: the 7 UTD Dining locations with their

   outage* on a component to see a downtime alert and an incident, then end it. *Disable* "Friends & Leaderboard" and

| Downtime alert channel (UC-4) | `services/AlertNotifier` | `stubs/LoggingAlertNotifier` — logs the alert and shows it on the dashboard |

## 8. REST API overview

All endpoints except register, login and health need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

| Area | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register`, `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/verify`, `POST /api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me` |
| Profile (FR-3) | `GET/PUT /api/profile`, `PUT /api/profile/password`, `PUT /api/profile/goals` |
| Nutrition (UC-1) | `POST /api/nutrition/meals/photo`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/locations`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/location-info` (TD-6: building, menu, source), `GET /api/nutrition/menu?location=`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/meals`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/water`, `GET /api/nutrition/summary` |
| Activity (UC-2) | `POST/GET /api/activity/devices`, `DELETE /api/activity/devices/{id}`, `POST /api/activity/steps`, `GET /api/activity/records`, `POST /api/activity/visits` (reader), `GET /api/activity/visits`, `POST /api/activity/stub-reader/swipe` |
| Social (UC-3) | `GET /api/social/users/search?q=`, `GET /api/social/users/{id}`, `POST/GET /api/social/requests`, `POST /api/social/requests/{id}/accept\|decline`, `GET /api/social/friends`, `DELETE /api/social/friends/{id}`, `GET/PUT /api/social/consent`, `GET /api/social/friends/{id}/stats`, `GET /api/social/leaderboard` |
| Modules (FR-5) | `GET /api/modules`, `GET /api/modules/{id}` |
| Admin (UC-4) | `GET /api/admin/access`, `GET /api/admin/uptime?hours=`, `POST /api/admin/uptime/check-now`, `GET /api/admin/alerts`, `GET /api/admin/modules`, `POST /api/admin/modules/{id}/disable\|enable`, `POST /api/admin/health-check` (monitor), `POST /api/admin/stub/outage` |

Sign-in (stage 3, TD-5): `POST /api/auth/login` takes `username`, `password` and optional `deviceToken` (a remembered
device). It returns a session (`token`, `user`, `rememberedDevice: true`) only for a remembered device; otherwise
`verificationRequired: true` with a single-use `challengeId` (5 minutes) and **no** token. `POST /api/auth/verify`
takes `challengeId`, `totpCode` and optional `rememberDevice` and returns the session, plus `deviceToken` /
`trustedUntil` when the device was just remembered. `POST /api/auth/register` returns `totpSecret`, `otpauthUri` and a
`setupChallengeId` (15 minutes) that the first code completes through `/verify`. Every credential failure is the same
`401 "Invalid username, password or code"`. `POST /api/nutrition/water` takes `{"amount": 0.3, "isLiter": false}` (liters or gallons, team
`LogWater`) or `{"volumeMl": 500}`, and returns `message` (for example "Added 1.13L to Alice").

When a module is disabled, its endpoints answer `503 {"code":"MODULE_DISABLED"}` and the app shows a maintenance
notice.

## Troubleshooting

- **"Cannot reach the CometFit server"** in the app: the server isn't running, or `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` is wrong.
- **"Invalid username, password or code" on Verify it's you:** the 6-digit code is wrong or expired, the laptop clock
  is off, or the sign-in step timed out (5 minutes) / had 5 wrong codes — press *Back to sign in* and start again.
- **Port 8080 already in use:** set `PORT=8090` before starting the server, and set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8090` for the client.
- **CORS error in the browser:** add the page's origin to `COMETFIT_CORS_ORIGINS`.
- **"Could not decrypt field":** `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY` changed after the accounts were created. Restore the old key or reset the database.

Start from clean demo data (`docker compose down -v`, then `docker compose up --build`).

0. **Sign-in (TD-5, TD-1)** — Sign in as `alice` with username and password; *Verify it's you* asks for the code.
   Tick *Remember this device for 30 days* and *Verify*. Log out (Account) and sign in again: no second step. To

   accepted. Tap *+ Log food*: log a meal manually, then *Dining menu*: the 7 UTD Dining locations with their

## 8. REST API overview

All endpoints except register, login and health need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

| Area | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register`, `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/verify`, `POST /api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me` |
| Profile (FR-3) | `GET/PUT /api/profile`, `PUT /api/profile/password`, `PUT /api/profile/goals` |
| Nutrition (UC-1) | `POST /api/nutrition/meals/photo`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/locations`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/location-info` (TD-6: building, menu, source), `GET /api/nutrition/menu?location=`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/meals`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/water`, `GET /api/nutrition/summary` |
| Activity (UC-2) | `POST/GET /api/activity/devices`, `DELETE /api/activity/devices/{id}`, `POST /api/activity/steps`, `GET /api/activity/records`, `POST /api/activity/visits` (reader), `GET /api/activity/visits`, `POST /api/activity/stub-reader/swipe` |
| Social (UC-3) | `GET /api/social/users/search?q=`, `GET /api/social/users/{id}`, `POST/GET /api/social/requests`, `POST /api/social/requests/{id}/accept\|decline`, `GET /api/social/friends`, `DELETE /api/social/friends/{id}`, `GET/PUT /api/social/consent`, `GET /api/social/friends/{id}/stats`, `GET /api/social/leaderboard` |
| Modules (FR-5) | `GET /api/modules`, `GET /api/modules/{id}` |
| Admin (UC-4) | `GET /api/admin/access`, `GET /api/admin/uptime?hours=`, `POST /api/admin/uptime/check-now`, `GET /api/admin/alerts`, `GET /api/admin/modules`, `POST /api/admin/modules/{id}/disable\|enable`, `POST /api/admin/health-check` (monitor), `POST /api/admin/stub/outage` |

Sign-in (stage 3, TD-5): `POST /api/auth/login` takes `username`, `password` and optional `deviceToken` (a remembered
device). It returns a session (`token`, `user`, `rememberedDevice: true`) only for a remembered device; otherwise
`verificationRequired: true` with a single-use `challengeId` (5 minutes) and **no** token. `POST /api/auth/verify`
takes `challengeId`, `totpCode` and optional `rememberDevice` and returns the session, plus `deviceToken` /
`trustedUntil` when the device was just remembered. `POST /api/auth/register` returns `totpSecret`, `otpauthUri` and a
`setupChallengeId` (15 minutes) that the first code completes through `/verify`. Every credential failure is the same
`401 "Invalid username, password or code"`. `POST /api/nutrition/water` takes `{"amount": 0.3, "isLiter": false}` (liters or gallons, team
`LogWater`) or `{"volumeMl": 500}`, and returns `message` (for example "Added 1.13L to Alice").

When a module is disabled, its endpoints answer `503 {"code":"MODULE_DISABLED"}` and the app shows a maintenance
notice.

## Troubleshooting

- **"Cannot reach the CometFit server"** in the app: the server isn't running, or `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` is wrong.
- **"Invalid username, password or code" on Verify it's you:** the 6-digit code is wrong or expired, the laptop clock
  is off, or the sign-in step timed out (5 minutes) / had 5 wrong codes — press *Back to sign in* and start again.
- **Port 8080 already in use:** set `PORT=8090` before starting the server, and set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8090` for the client.
- **CORS error in the browser:** add the page's origin to `COMETFIT_CORS_ORIGINS`.
- **"Could not decrypt field":** `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY` changed after the accounts were created. Restore the old key or reset the database.

# CometFit — local setup and demo guide

CometFit (SE 3354 Team 9) is a student health-tracking app: meals and water (UC-1), activity and UREC visits (UC-2),
friends' progress (UC-3), and developer monitoring and control (UC-4). It was built only from the team's Proposal,
Deliverable 1, the Deliverable 2 draft, the team's water-logging unit code, team decisions TD-1..TD-5 and the team's Figma prototype screens (all in `../spec/`). `../TRACEABILITY.md` maps every requirement to code and tests. `../ASSUMPTIONS.md` lists every gap
that had to be filled.

```
app/
├── server/            Spring Boot REST server: API gateway, auth gateway, Nutrition / Activity / Social / Admin services
├── client/            Expo (React Native) mobile app — also runs in a web browser for the demo
├── tools/             totp.mjs (prints sign-in codes), smoke.mjs (end-to-end HTTP check), demo-check.mjs (read-only)
└── docker-compose.yml MySQL 8.4 database + the server
```

The architecture follows Deliverable 1 §5.3 (client-server): the mobile client talks to one REST API, and every call
goes through the auth gateway (password + TOTP sessions, permissions list) and the module (feature-flag) check before
it reaches a service. Outside systems (AI food recognition, UTD Dining menus, smart devices, the UREC card reader,
the monitoring service and the alert channel) are **stubs**. They are labelled `*** STUB ***` in the code and listed at
the end of this file.

---

## 1. Install prerequisites

| Tool | Version used | Check with |
|---|---|---|
| Java JDK | 21 or newer (built with 23) | `java -version` |
| Maven | 3.9+ | `mvn -v` |
| Node.js + npm | Node 22+ | `node -v` |
| Docker Desktop | recommended (MySQL + server) | `docker version` |

Without Docker, use the embedded H2 database (step 4, option B).

## 2. Install dependencies

```bash
# server (downloads the Maven dependencies)
cd app/server
mvn -DskipTests package

# client
cd ../client
npm install
```

## 3. Configure environment variables

Every variable has a development default, so **nothing needs to be set for a local demo**. For anything shared, set
at least `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY`, `DB_PASSWORD`, `DB_ROOT_PASSWORD` and `COMETFIT_INTEGRATION_KEY`.

### Server (`app/server`)

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `PORT` | `8080` | HTTP port |
| `DB_URL` | `jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/cometfit` (H2 file `./data/cometfit-mysql` with the `h2` profile) | JDBC URL |
| `DB_USER` / `DB_PASSWORD` | `cometfit` / `cometfit` | Database login |
| `DB_ROOT_PASSWORD` | `root` | MySQL root password (docker-compose only) |
| `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY` | development key | Base64 32-byte AES key that encrypts emails and TOTP secrets at rest. Generate one: `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))"`. **Changing it makes existing accounts unreadable.** |
| `COMETFIT_INTEGRATION_KEY` | `dev-integration-key` | Shared secret that the UREC card reader and the external monitor send in the `X-Integration-Key` header |
| `COMETFIT_ZONE` | `America/Chicago` | Time zone that defines "today" for daily totals |
| `COMETFIT_SESSION_HOURS` | `12` | Session lifetime |
| `COMETFIT_REMEMBER_DEVICE_DAYS` | `30` | How long "Remember this device" skips the 6-digit code (TD-1) |
| `COMETFIT_MONITOR_INTERVAL_SEC` | `30` | Health-check interval of the monitoring stub |
| `COMETFIT_MONITOR_STUB` | `true` | Run the built-in monitoring-service stub |
| `COMETFIT_SEED_DEMO` | `true` | Create the demo accounts below on start-up |
| `COMETFIT_CORS_ORIGINS` | `http://localhost:8081,http://localhost:19006` | Browser origins allowed to call the API |

### Client (`app/client`)

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` (`http://10.0.2.2:8080` on the Android emulator) | Server base URL |

To set variables: in bash, `export NAME=value`. In PowerShell, `$env:NAME = "value"`. You can also put client
variables in `app/client/.env` (this file is git-ignored).

## 4. Run the project locally

### Start the database and server

**Option A — everything in Docker (recommended)**

```bash
cd app
docker compose up --build        # MySQL 8.4 on localhost:3306 + the server on localhost:8080
```

Add `-d` to run it in the background. The server waits until MySQL is healthy. The first build downloads the Maven
dependencies inside the image, so it takes a few minutes.

**Option A2 — MySQL in Docker, server from Maven (for development)**

```bash
cd app
docker compose up -d db
cd server
mvn spring-boot:run
```

**Option B — no Docker (embedded H2 file database in MySQL mode)**

```bash
cd app/server
mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=h2
```

| Downtime alert channel (UC-4) | `services/AlertNotifier` | `stubs/LoggingAlertNotifier` — logs the alert and shows it on the dashboard |
| A real outage (demo only) | — | `stubs/OutageSimulator` — the "Simulate outage" button |

## 8. REST API overview

All endpoints except register, login and health need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

| Area | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register`, `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/verify`, `POST /api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me` |
| Profile (FR-3) | `GET/PUT /api/profile`, `PUT /api/profile/password`, `PUT /api/profile/goals` |
| Nutrition (UC-1) | `POST /api/nutrition/meals/photo`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/locations`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/location-info` (TD-6: building, menu, source), `GET /api/nutrition/menu?location=`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/meals`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/water`, `GET /api/nutrition/summary` |
| Activity (UC-2) | `POST/GET /api/activity/devices`, `DELETE /api/activity/devices/{id}`, `POST /api/activity/steps`, `GET /api/activity/records`, `POST /api/activity/visits` (reader), `GET /api/activity/visits`, `POST /api/activity/stub-reader/swipe` |
| Social (UC-3) | `GET /api/social/users/search?q=`, `GET /api/social/users/{id}`, `POST/GET /api/social/requests`, `POST /api/social/requests/{id}/accept\|decline`, `GET /api/social/friends`, `DELETE /api/social/friends/{id}`, `GET/PUT /api/social/consent`, `GET /api/social/friends/{id}/stats`, `GET /api/social/leaderboard` |
| Modules (FR-5) | `GET /api/modules`, `GET /api/modules/{id}` |
| Admin (UC-4) | `GET /api/admin/access`, `GET /api/admin/uptime?hours=`, `POST /api/admin/uptime/check-now`, `GET /api/admin/alerts`, `GET /api/admin/modules`, `POST /api/admin/modules/{id}/disable\|enable`, `POST /api/admin/health-check` (monitor), `POST /api/admin/stub/outage` |

Sign-in (stage 3, TD-5): `POST /api/auth/login` takes `username`, `password` and optional `deviceToken` (a remembered
device). It returns a session (`token`, `user`, `rememberedDevice: true`) only for a remembered device; otherwise
`verificationRequired: true` with a single-use `challengeId` (5 minutes) and **no** token. `POST /api/auth/verify`
takes `challengeId`, `totpCode` and optional `rememberDevice` and returns the session, plus `deviceToken` /
`trustedUntil` when the device was just remembered. `POST /api/auth/register` returns `totpSecret`, `otpauthUri` and a
`setupChallengeId` (15 minutes) that the first code completes through `/verify`. Every credential failure is the same
`401 "Invalid username, password or code"`. `POST /api/nutrition/water` takes `{"amount": 0.3, "isLiter": false}` (liters or gallons, team
`LogWater`) or `{"volumeMl": 500}`, and returns `message` (for example "Added 1.13L to Alice").

When a module is disabled, its endpoints answer `503 {"code":"MODULE_DISABLED"}` and the app shows a maintenance
notice.

## Troubleshooting

- **"Cannot reach the CometFit server"** in the app: the server isn't running, or `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` is wrong.
- **"Invalid username, password or code" on Verify it's you:** the 6-digit code is wrong or expired, the laptop clock
  is off, or the sign-in step timed out (5 minutes) / had 5 wrong codes — press *Back to sign in* and start again.
- **Port 8080 already in use:** set `PORT=8090` before starting the server, and set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8090` for the client.
- **CORS error in the browser:** add the page's origin to `COMETFIT_CORS_ORIGINS`.
- **"Could not decrypt field":** `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY` changed after the accounts were created. Restore the old key or reset the database.

# CometFit — local setup and demo guide

CometFit (SE 3354 Team 9) is a student health-tracking app: meals and water (UC-1), activity and UREC visits (UC-2),
friends' progress (UC-3), and developer monitoring and control (UC-4). It was built only from the team's Proposal,
Deliverable 1, the Deliverable 2 draft, the team's water-logging unit code, team decisions TD-1..TD-5 and the team's Figma prototype screens (all in `../spec/`). `../TRACEABILITY.md` maps every requirement to code and tests. `../ASSUMPTIONS.md` lists every gap
that had to be filled.

```
app/
├── server/            Spring Boot REST server: API gateway, auth gateway, Nutrition / Activity / Social / Admin services
├── client/            Expo (React Native) mobile app — also runs in a web browser for the demo
├── tools/             totp.mjs (prints sign-in codes), smoke.mjs (end-to-end HTTP check), demo-check.mjs (read-only)
└── docker-compose.yml MySQL 8.4 database + the server
```

The architecture follows Deliverable 1 §5.3 (client-server): the mobile client talks to one REST API, and every call
goes through the auth gateway (password + TOTP sessions, permissions list) and the module (feature-flag) check before
it reaches a service. Outside systems (AI food recognition, UTD Dining menus, smart devices, the UREC card reader,
the monitoring service and the alert channel) are **stubs**. They are labelled `*** STUB ***` in the code and listed at
the end of this file.

---

## 1. Install prerequisites

| Tool | Version used | Check with |
|---|---|---|
| Java JDK | 21 or newer (built with 23) | `java -version` |
| Maven | 3.9+ | `mvn -v` |
| Node.js + npm | Node 22+ | `node -v` |
| Docker Desktop | recommended (MySQL + server) | `docker version` |

Without Docker, use the embedded H2 database (step 4, option B).

## 2. Install dependencies

```bash
# server (downloads the Maven dependencies)
cd app/server
mvn -DskipTests package

# client
cd ../client
npm install
```

## 3. Configure environment variables

Every variable has a development default, so **nothing needs to be set for a local demo**. For anything shared, set
at least `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY`, `DB_PASSWORD`, `DB_ROOT_PASSWORD` and `COMETFIT_INTEGRATION_KEY`.

### Server (`app/server`)

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `PORT` | `8080` | HTTP port |
| `DB_URL` | `jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/cometfit` (H2 file `./data/cometfit-mysql` with the `h2` profile) | JDBC URL |
| `DB_USER` / `DB_PASSWORD` | `cometfit` / `cometfit` | Database login |
| `DB_ROOT_PASSWORD` | `root` | MySQL root password (docker-compose only) |
| `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY` | development key | Base64 32-byte AES key that encrypts emails and TOTP secrets at rest. Generate one: `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))"`. **Changing it makes existing accounts unreadable.** |
| `COMETFIT_INTEGRATION_KEY` | `dev-integration-key` | Shared secret that the UREC card reader and the external monitor send in the `X-Integration-Key` header |
| `COMETFIT_ZONE` | `America/Chicago` | Time zone that defines "today" for daily totals |
| `COMETFIT_SESSION_HOURS` | `12` | Session lifetime |
| `COMETFIT_REMEMBER_DEVICE_DAYS` | `30` | How long "Remember this device" skips the 6-digit code (TD-1) |
| `COMETFIT_MONITOR_INTERVAL_SEC` | `30` | Health-check interval of the monitoring stub |
| `COMETFIT_MONITOR_STUB` | `true` | Run the built-in monitoring-service stub |
| `COMETFIT_SEED_DEMO` | `true` | Create the demo accounts below on start-up |
| `COMETFIT_CORS_ORIGINS` | `http://localhost:8081,http://localhost:19006` | Browser origins allowed to call the API |

### Client (`app/client`)

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` (`http://10.0.2.2:8080` on the Android emulator) | Server base URL |

To set variables: in bash, `export NAME=value`. In PowerShell, `$env:NAME = "value"`. You can also put client
variables in `app/client/.env` (this file is git-ignored).

## 4. Run the project locally

### Start the database and server

**Option A — everything in Docker (recommended)**

```bash
cd app
docker compose up --build        # MySQL 8.4 on localhost:3306 + the server on localhost:8080
```

Add `-d` to run it in the background. The server waits until MySQL is healthy. The first build downloads the Maven
dependencies inside the image, so it takes a few minutes.

**Option A2 — MySQL in Docker, server from Maven (for development)**

```bash
cd app
docker compose up -d db
cd server
mvn spring-boot:run
```

**Option B — no Docker (embedded H2 file database in MySQL mode)**

```bash
cd app/server
mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=h2
```

Flyway creates the schema on first start (`V1` schema, `V2` water log in liters, `V3` remembered devices, `V4` sign-in
challenges for TD-5, `V5` UTD Dining building / serving size and nullable macros for TD-6). The server
is ready when <http://localhost:8080/actuator/health> shows `{"status":"UP"}`.

**Start the demo over with clean data** (removes everything, including test leftovers, then re-seeds the demo accounts):

```bash
cd app
docker compose down -v           # -v deletes the MySQL volume
docker compose up --build
```

With option B, stop the server and delete `app/server/data/` instead. *(Upgrading from the stage-1 PostgreSQL build:
the old `app_cometfit-db` volume and old H2 files are not used any more; delete them.)*

### Start the client

```bash
cd app/client
npm run web            # opens http://localhost:8081 in the browser
```

For a phone-like view in the browser, use the dev tools' device toolbar. On a real phone, run `npx expo start` and
open the app in Expo Go. Set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` to your laptop's LAN address, for example
`http://192.168.1.20:8080`.

### Sign in

| Username | Password | TOTP secret | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alice` | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITALICE234` | Student |
| `bob` | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITBOBBY567` | Student |
| `starryskies23` (Sky) | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITSTARRY23` | Student (TD-8): water leader |
| `nebulanomad` (Nova) | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITNEBULA45` | Student (TD-8): logs the most calories |
| `lunarlifter` (Luna) | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITLUNAR567` | Student (TD-8) |
| `orbitrunner` (Theo) | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITORBIT234` | Student (TD-8): UREC regular, most points |
| `cosmocomet` (Cass) | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITCOSMO345` | Student (TD-8): not a friend yet; pending friend request to alice |
| `dev` | `CometFit123!` | `COMETFITDEVADMIN` | Developer (admin dashboard) |

Sign-in has two steps (team decision TD-5):

1. **Sign in** — enter the username and password and press *Sign in*. No code is asked here.
2. **Verify it's you** — shown only when this browser/phone is not remembered. Enter the current 6-digit code from
   Duo Mobile (or any authenticator app with the secret above added), or print it with:

   ```bash
   node app/tools/totp.mjs COMETFITALICE234
   ```

   Tick **Remember this device for 30 days** to skip step 2 next time on this browser/phone (TD-1). The code is
   needed again on a new device, after 30 days, after a password change, or after *Account → Two-step verification →
   Forget this device*. The sign-in step expires after 5 minutes; if it does, press *Back to sign in*.

**Register** (from *New student? Create an account*) asks only for the account details. The next screen, **Set up
two-step verification**, shows a QR code to scan with Duo Mobile (on every screen size), plus **Add to authenticator
app** and **Copy setup key**. Enter the first 6-digit code and press *Finish setup* to sign in.

The six demo students `alice`, `bob`, `starryskies23`, `nebulanomad`, `lunarlifter` and `orbitrunner` are all
friends with each other, share all their stats, and have a week of meals, water, steps, UREC visits and points,
today included (TD-2, TD-8); their meals are real UTD Dining items (TD-6). On alice's Social screen every board lists
six people and alice is neither first nor last on any of them. `cosmocomet` has sent alice a friend request that is
still pending (TD-8). "Today" is the day the demo data was reset; on a later day, reset again. Accounts you register
yourself share nothing until you turn sharing on.

## 5. Run the tests

```bash
cd app/server && mvn test        # 76 API/unit tests on H2 (MySQL mode): Uc1..Uc4, WaterLogTest (team TC-1..TC-3),
                                 # RememberDeviceTest (TD-1), DemoDataTest (TD-2, TD-6), TwoStepSignInTest (TD-5),
                                 # Td6UtdDiningTest + StubUtdDiningFeedTest (TD-6), Td8DemoFriendsTest (TD-8), security
cd app/client && npm test        # 32 client unit tests (Node test runner), incl. authFlow (TD-5), td6Dining (TD-6)
cd app/client && npm run typecheck
cd app/client && npx expo export --platform web   # production web build in app/client/dist (= npm run export:web)

# End-to-end over real HTTP against a running server (uses the demo accounts; it logs meals/water for alice,
# so reset the demo data afterwards if you want it clean):
node app/tools/smoke.mjs http://localhost:8080
# Read-only: demo accounts sign in, TD-6 dining data, demo meals, TD-8 six-person boards and pending request
# (writes no demo data):
node app/tools/demo-check.mjs http://localhost:8080
```

## 6. Demo script (about 5 minutes)

Start from clean demo data (`docker compose down -v`, then `docker compose up --build`).

The five tabs follow the team's Figma prototype (TD-4): **Dashboard, Food & Water, Activities, Social, Account**.

0. **Sign-in (TD-5, TD-1)** — Sign in as `alice` with username and password; *Verify it's you* asks for the code.
   Tick *Remember this device for 30 days* and *Verify*. Log out (Account) and sign in again: no second step. To
   show sign-up, register a new student: *Set up two-step verification* shows the QR code for Duo Mobile, *Add to
   authenticator app* and *Copy setup key*; enter the first code to finish.
1. **UC-1** — **Dashboard** shows the UREC streak and a *Today* card (calories, water, steps, low-water message). On
   **Food & Water**, tap *+ 500 ml* (one bottle refill). Tap *Other amount (L / gal)*, enter `0.3`, choose *gal* and
   tap *Add 1.13 L*: the app answers "Added 1.13L to Alice" (water is stored in liters). A negative amount is not
   accepted. Tap *+ Log food*: log a meal manually, then *Dining menu*: the 7 UTD Dining locations with their
   buildings (TD-6). Open *Dining Hall West (Andromeda Hall)* — calories only, macros "not published" — and *Add*
   *Italian Nachos*; the macro totals note that it counts as 0 g. Open *Chick-fil-A* to show an item with published
   macros. Then *Photo (AI)* → pick any image, edit the estimate, *Confirm & save*. *Today's log* lists every entry;
   *Week* / *Month* show averages per day. alice's and bob's earlier days are real UTD Dining items (TD-6 §5).
2. **Safety** — in **Account → Daily goals & units**, enter 800 kcal or 6000 ml and watch the warnings appear.
3. **UC-2** — **Activities** → *+ Connect smart device* → *Allow* (simulated health prompt) → *+ Sync activity from
   device*. Then *Check in at UREC* (here or on the Dashboard): +10 points, the visit appears in the history and the
   Dashboard streak updates.
4. **UC-3** — **Social**: the friends leaderboards (water, calories, UREC visits, points) show alice and bob (TD-2).
   Open bob's *Stats*. In **Account → Privacy & data** turn one of alice's sharing switches off, then in a second
   (private) browser window sign in as `bob` and see alice drop off that board and the stat show "Not shared". To
   show friend requests, register a new student and send `alice` a request (*Find people*).
5. **UC-4** — Sign in as `dev`. The developer dashboard shows uptime % and per-component status. Click *Simulate
   outage* on a component to see a downtime alert and an incident, then end it. *Disable* "Friends & Leaderboard" and
   switch to bob's window: the Social tab shows the maintenance notice while the other tabs keep working.
   *Re-enable* it.

Not built on purpose: the Proposal's water refill map (team decision TD-3, `../ASSUMPTIONS.md` A-41).

## 7. Stubs (external systems from the spec)

| External actor in the spec | Interface | Stub implementation |
|---|---|---|
| AI Food Recognition Service (UC-1) | `services/AIFoodService` | `stubs/FakeAIFoodService` — deterministic estimate from the image hash |
| UTD Dining menu data (UC-1, FR-8) | `services/UtdDiningFeed` | `stubs/StubUtdDiningFeed` — TD-6: the 7 UTD Dining locations / 54 items of `spec/06-utd-dining` (Monday 2026-11-16 menus, classpath copy `utd-dining/…json`), same menu every day, no live calls |
| Smart Device pairing (UC-2) | `services/SmartDeviceGateway` | `stubs/FakeSmartDeviceGateway` — always pairs, except device ids starting with `FAIL` |
| Smart Device readings + health permission (UC-2) | client `src/smartDevice.ts` `SmartDeviceAdapter` | `FakeSmartDevice` — simulated steps / heart rate |
| UREC Card Reader (UC-2) | `POST /api/activity/visits` with the integration key | `stubs/FakeUrecCardReader` — the "Check in at UREC" buttons (Dashboard, Activities) |
| Monitoring Service (UC-4) | `POST /api/admin/health-check` with the integration key | `stubs/MonitoringAgentStub` — timer inside the server |
| Downtime alert channel (UC-4) | `services/AlertNotifier` | `stubs/LoggingAlertNotifier` — logs the alert and shows it on the dashboard |
| A real outage (demo only) | — | `stubs/OutageSimulator` — the "Simulate outage" button |

## 8. REST API overview

All endpoints except register, login and health need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

| Area | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register`, `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/verify`, `POST /api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me` |
| Profile (FR-3) | `GET/PUT /api/profile`, `PUT /api/profile/password`, `PUT /api/profile/goals` |
| Nutrition (UC-1) | `POST /api/nutrition/meals/photo`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/locations`, `GET /api/nutrition/menu/location-info` (TD-6: building, menu, source), `GET /api/nutrition/menu?location=`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/meals`, `POST/GET /api/nutrition/water`, `GET /api/nutrition/summary` |
| Activity (UC-2) | `POST/GET /api/activity/devices`, `DELETE /api/activity/devices/{id}`, `POST /api/activity/steps`, `GET /api/activity/records`, `POST /api/activity/visits` (reader), `GET /api/activity/visits`, `POST /api/activity/stub-reader/swipe` |
| Social (UC-3) | `GET /api/social/users/search?q=`, `GET /api/social/users/{id}`, `POST/GET /api/social/requests`, `POST /api/social/requests/{id}/accept\|decline`, `GET /api/social/friends`, `DELETE /api/social/friends/{id}`, `GET/PUT /api/social/consent`, `GET /api/social/friends/{id}/stats`, `GET /api/social/leaderboard` |
| Modules (FR-5) | `GET /api/modules`, `GET /api/modules/{id}` |
| Admin (UC-4) | `GET /api/admin/access`, `GET /api/admin/uptime?hours=`, `POST /api/admin/uptime/check-now`, `GET /api/admin/alerts`, `GET /api/admin/modules`, `POST /api/admin/modules/{id}/disable\|enable`, `POST /api/admin/health-check` (monitor), `POST /api/admin/stub/outage` |

Sign-in (stage 3, TD-5): `POST /api/auth/login` takes `username`, `password` and optional `deviceToken` (a remembered
device). It returns a session (`token`, `user`, `rememberedDevice: true`) only for a remembered device; otherwise
`verificationRequired: true` with a single-use `challengeId` (5 minutes) and **no** token. `POST /api/auth/verify`
takes `challengeId`, `totpCode` and optional `rememberDevice` and returns the session, plus `deviceToken` /
`trustedUntil` when the device was just remembered. `POST /api/auth/register` returns `totpSecret`, `otpauthUri` and a
`setupChallengeId` (15 minutes) that the first code completes through `/verify`. Every credential failure is the same
`401 "Invalid username, password or code"`. `POST /api/nutrition/water` takes `{"amount": 0.3, "isLiter": false}` (liters or gallons, team
`LogWater`) or `{"volumeMl": 500}`, and returns `message` (for example "Added 1.13L to Alice").

When a module is disabled, its endpoints answer `503 {"code":"MODULE_DISABLED"}` and the app shows a maintenance
notice.

## Troubleshooting

- **"Cannot reach the CometFit server"** in the app: the server isn't running, or `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL` is wrong.
- **"Invalid username, password or code" on Verify it's you:** the 6-digit code is wrong or expired, the laptop clock
  is off, or the sign-in step timed out (5 minutes) / had 5 wrong codes — press *Back to sign in* and start again.
- **Port 8080 already in use:** set `PORT=8090` before starting the server, and set `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8090` for the client.
- **CORS error in the browser:** add the page's origin to `COMETFIT_CORS_ORIGINS`.
- **"Could not decrypt field":** `COMETFIT_DATA_KEY` changed after the accounts were created. Restore the old key or reset the database.

TD-8 is in and working on the live server. Alice's Social screen now shows six people on every board, and she is neither first nor last on any of them.

**What I built**
- **Four new demo friends:** starryskies23 (Sky), nebulanomad (Nova), lunarlifter (Luna) and orbitrunner (Theo). Like alice and bob, they share all their data and have a week of history: meals from the real UTD Dining items, water, steps, UREC visits and points.
- **Friend group:** all six demo students are friends with each other.
- **Pending request:** cosmocomet (Cass) has sent alice a friend request, so the Friend requests list isn't empty in the demo.
- **Reset:** rebuilding from a wiped database recreates all of this. Restarting the server without a reset doesn't add anything twice.
- **No changes** to behavior, the API or the UI. Alice's and bob's existing weeks are unchanged.

**One fix TD-8 needed:** the old demo data only logged today's entries up to the time of the reset, so a morning reset left today's boards nearly empty. Now each student's whole plan for today is logged whenever the reset happens (recorded as assumption A-61). This also applies to alice and bob. "Today" is the day of the reset, so the data needs resetting again on the day of the recording.

**Checks I ran**
- **Server tests:** 76 of 76 pass. That's the 70 existing ones, one of which now expects a six-person leaderboard instead of two, plus 6 new TD-8 tests.
- **Restart and reset:** rebuilt and restarted the server with `docker compose up -d --build server`, then reset the demo data (`down -v` and up again). The log shows all seven demo students created.
- **Read-only demo check:** all 19 checks pass. I extended it to cover TD-8. Alice's boards on the live server (no ties next to alice):

| Board | 1st | 2nd | 3rd | 4th | 5th | 6th |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Points | orbitrunner 100 | starryskies23 80 | **alice 65** | lunarlifter 45 | nebulanomad 40 | bob 30 |
| Water today (ml) | starryskies23 3000 | nebulanomad 2500 | lunarlifter 2000 | orbitrunner 1500 | **alice 1000** | bob 500 |
| Calories today | nebulanomad 2790 | bob 2177 | lunarlifter 1675 | orbitrunner 1565 | **alice 1100** | starryskies23 895 |
| UREC visits (7 days) | orbitrunner 7 | starryskies23 6 | **alice 5** | lunarlifter 4 | nebulanomad 3 | bob 2 |

I left the web dev server on port 8081 running. I couldn't look at the Social screen in a browser in this run. No client code changed, so I didn't re-run the client tests.

**Docs**
- `app/README.md`: the five new accounts with their TOTP secrets, plus an updated Social step in the demo script (accept Cass's request and the boards grow to seven).
- `ASSUMPTIONS.md`: A-40 marked partly superseded by TD-8, and new A-61 to A-65. These cover which boards count, the exact numbers, Cass getting a week of history but no friends, restart behavior, and the secrets and emails.
- `TRACEABILITY.md`: TD-8 row and the UC-3 row updated.
- `BUILD_LOG.md`: stage 6, steps 56 to 62.

There are three commits, each citing TD-8: the demo data with its tests, the demo check, and the docs. Nothing was pushed, and the untracked `proof/transcripts` files were left alone.

cd /c/CometFit-cleanroom/build/app/server/src/main/java/cometfit && grep -n "STEP_GOAL\|VISIT\|pointsFor\|case\|return" services/PointsService.java | head -20; grep -n "Today\|ThisWeek\|minusDays\|between" services/PrivacyService.java | head -20; cat services/Clock.java | grep -n "zone\|Zone\|today\|startOf"

cd /c/CometFit-cleanroom/build/app/server/src && grep -v "^import" main/java/cometfit/domain/FriendshipRepository.java main/java/cometfit/domain/FriendRequestRepository.java | grep -v "^\s*$"; grep -n "protected\|public\|record" test/java/cometfit/ApiTestSupport.java | head -30
for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s localhost:8080/actuator/health | grep -q UP && break; sleep 3; done; docker logs app-server-1 2>&1 | grep -E "Seeded|ERROR|Exception" | head -20

until docker logs app-server-1 2>&1 | grep -qE "Started CometFit|APPLICATION FAILED|Exception"; do sleep 1; done; docker logs app-server-1 2>&1 | grep -E "Seeded|Started CometFit|ERROR|APPLICATION FAILED" | head -20
